compose_prompt: Write the Introduction chapter for a quantitative thesis on how live-streaming commerce affordances shape consumers' purchase intention. Ground the argument in the S-O-R framework, state the research gap, and end with the research questions. Academic register, ~350 words.

m1_topic.research_title: IT affordances of live-streaming commerce and consumer purchase intention: an S-O-R perspective
research_questions: How do live-streaming IT affordances influence purchase intention?
Does perceived trust mediate the affordance-intention link?

literature_sources.title: How live streaming influences purchase intentions in social commerce

research_gaps: Affordance-level (not platform-level) drivers of purchase intention in live commerce are under-examined.
